question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Neither the manager / nor the employees was / aware of the / shortage of raw materials
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**nor the employees was**".

• The **error is in the part "nor the employees was"** of the sentence.
